products.name: Velo Stride 7
products.description: Neutral daily trainer, 8 mm drop, 262 g. Foam midsole that stays lively for about 600 km.
review_quotes: Light enough for tempo days, soft enough for easy miles.
Runs half a size small.

products.name: Trailhead GTX
products.description: Waterproof trail shoe, 4 mm lugs, rock plate. Heavier at 318 g but holds a muddy line.
review_quotes: Dry feet through three winter months.
Too warm for summer road use.

products.name: Pace Lite 3
products.description: Budget trainer, 221 g, firm ride. A sensible first pair or gym shoe.
review_quotes: Great value, outsole wears fast on tarmac.
Narrow toe box.

products.name: Quiet Q30
products.description: Over-ear active noise cancelling, 38 h battery, USB-C, multipoint to two devices.
review_quotes: Cabin noise on a plane basically disappears.
The case is bulky for a backpack.

products.name: Buds Air 2
products.description: In-ear, 6 h per charge, 24 h with the case, IPX4 sweat resistant.
review_quotes: Fine for calls and the gym.
Noise cancelling is mild.

products.name: Studio One
products.description: Open-back wired reference headphone, 250 ohm. Needs a headphone amplifier.
review_quotes: The most honest pair I have owned.
No isolation at all, strictly home use.

products.name: Nimbus 14 Air
products.description: 14-inch 2.8K screen, 16-core ARM chip, 1.2 kg, 18 h battery. No discrete GPU.
review_quotes: Silent and cool, you never hear the fan.
Only two USB-C ports.

products.name: Forge 16 Pro
products.description: 16-inch workstation, 12 GB VRAM GPU, 2.4 kg. Loud under sustained load.
review_quotes: Trains small models fine.
Battery life halves the moment the GPU wakes up.

products.name: Barista Pro Grinder
products.description: Conical burr grinder, 40 settings, espresso through french press.
review_quotes: The espresso range is real, not marketing.
Static makes a mess on dry days.

products.name: Moka 6-cup
products.description: Aluminium stovetop espresso maker. Not induction compatible.
review_quotes: Does exactly one thing, and does it well.
The handle gets hot, use a cloth.

products.name: Chef Knife 20cm
products.description: Hand-forged carbon steel gyuto. Takes a patina with use, hand wash only.
review_quotes: Holds an edge for months.
Rusts if you leave it wet, as expected.

products.name: Transit 28L
products.description: Carry-on backpack, 28 L, laptop sleeve to 16 inch, fits European cabin rules.
review_quotes: Two weeks of travel with no check-in bag.
Water bottle pocket is tight.

products.name: Day Sling 4L
products.description: Crossbody sling for phone, passport and a charger. YKK zips.
review_quotes: Perfect airport sling.
Strap slips on smooth jackets.

products.name: Lumen Desk Lamp
products.description: LED desk lamp, 2700-6000 K, 95 CRI, USB-C passthrough.
review_quotes: Colour accuracy is genuinely good.
Touch controls are fiddly.

products.name: Monitor Riser Oak
products.description: Solid wood riser, 60 x 22 cm, holds 25 kg, cable channel at the back.
review_quotes: Solid, no wobble with two screens.
Assembly instructions are one picture.

products.name: Shelter 2P Tent
products.description: Two-person three-season tent, 2.1 kg packed, 3000 mm flysheet.
review_quotes: Pitched it in rain on the first try.
Inner is snug for two people plus gear.

products.name: Down Jacket 800
products.description: 800-fill responsible down, 340 g, packs into its own pocket.
review_quotes: Warm well below freezing.
The shell snags easily, treat it gently.

products.name: Track Watch S2
products.description: Dual-band GPS, 14-day battery, route maps on the wrist, no mobile data.
review_quotes: GPS track stays clean between tall buildings.
The phone app is slow to sync.
